a99bdcc9e779.en: Mini-Batch SGD and Epochs: the Golden Compromise Between "One Sample Is Too Noisy" and "the Full Batch Is Too Slow"

ef71e090dc3d.zh: 單樣本更新方差劇烈如醉漢，全批次計算巨慢且視訊記憶體崩潰！Mini-Batch SGD 每次隨機抽取 $b$ 筆樣本取均值，兼具隨機探索性與硬體並行效率。深度剖析無放回劃分式 (23)–(24)、Epoch 定義、命題 1 誤差界 $\mathcal{O}(1/t + \|e_t\|^2)$ 及方差衰減定理 $(1 - b/n)\frac{\sigma^2}{b}$。
ef71e090dc3d.en: Single-sample updates have a variance as wild as a drunkard's walk; the full batch computes painfully slowly and blows up GPU memory! Mini-batch SGD randomly draws $b$ samples each time and averages them, combining random exploration with hardware parallel efficiency. An in-depth look at the without-replacement partitioning of Eqs. (23)–(24), the definition of an epoch, the error bound of Proposition 1, $\mathcal{O}(1/t + \|e_t\|^2)$, and the variance decay theorem $(1 - b/n)\frac{\sigma^2}{b}$.

0d4d71982aed.zh:
「單筆太吵、全批太慢：Mini-Batch 如何成為深度學習的黃金折衷？」 單樣本步步隨機振盪，全批次視訊記憶體爆炸計算龜速！Mini-batch 結合 GPU 矩陣向量化與常數方差衰減，橫掃現代 AI 訓練架構！
Single-sample SGD suffers extreme variance while full-batch gradient descent is computationally prohibitive; Mini-Batch SGD achieves the golden compromise between variance reduction and GPU throughput!
0d4d71982aed.en: "One sample is too noisy and the full batch is too slow: how did the mini-batch become the golden compromise of deep learning?" Single samples oscillate randomly at every step; the full batch blows up GPU memory and computes at a snail's pace! The mini-batch combines GPU matrix vectorization with a variance decay by a constant factor, and it sweeps across modern AI training architectures!

3830bdf0156c.zh: 兩難抉擇與黃金折衷：為什麼需要 Mini-Batch SGD？ The Optimization Dilemma: Why Mini-Batch SGD Dominates Modern Deep Learning
3830bdf0156c.en: A dilemma and a golden compromise: why do we need mini-batch SGD?

0cc8767b846d.zh: 方差極大：每步只抽 1 筆樣本，梯度隨機噪聲高達 $\sigma^2$，軌跡如醉漢漫步，極度抖動。
0cc8767b846d.en: Huge variance: each step draws only 1 sample, the random gradient noise is as large as $\sigma^2$, and the trajectory jitters wildly like a drunkard's walk.

1a37b2221278.zh: 硬體浪費：無法填滿 GPU 數千核心，計算受限於記憶體頻寬（Memory Bandwidth Bound），算力利用率常低於 5%。
1a37b2221278.en: Wasted hardware: it cannot fill the thousands of GPU cores; computation is memory-bandwidth bound, and compute utilization is often below 5%.

e5b8918f7b68.zh: 優勢：單步計算成本極低，且劇烈噪聲具備極強的逃離鞍點與尖銳局部極小值能力。
e5b8918f7b68.en: Strength: each step is very cheap to compute, and the violent noise gives it a very strong ability to escape saddle points and sharp local minima.

fd893246805a.zh: 計算龜速：每更新一步必須完整遍歷資料集全體 $n$ 筆樣本，在海量資料集（如百萬影像或百億文字）下每步極度昂貴。
fd893246805a.en: Snail-paced computation: every update must traverse all $n$ samples of the dataset, so on massive datasets (millions of images or tens of billions of words of text) each step is extremely expensive.

2c83bea0a8fd.zh: 視訊記憶體爆炸：全資料集啟用值與梯度無法一次性塞入顯示卡 VRAM，直接引發 Out-Of-Memory (OOM)。
2c83bea0a8fd.en: GPU memory blowup: the activations and gradients of the whole dataset cannot fit into the graphics card's VRAM at once, which immediately triggers an out-of-memory (OOM) error.

a9978d1a903f.zh: 泛化欠佳：完全無噪聲的精確梯度容易收斂到平坦度較差的尖銳極小值（Sharp Minima）。
a9978d1a903f.en: Poorer generalization: the completely noise-free exact gradient tends to converge to sharp minima, which are less flat.

e3d00d24dd5b.zh: 黃金折衷：Mini-Batch SGD ($1 < b < n$)
e3d00d24dd5b.en: The golden compromise: mini-batch SGD ($1 < b < n$)

6aac19acc109.zh: 每次隨機抽取 $b$ 筆資料（Batch Size，批次大小），以這小批樣本的平均梯度進行參數更新！
6aac19acc109.en: Each time, randomly draw $b$ data points (the batch size) and update the parameters with the average gradient of this small batch of samples!

312569087e41.zh: 核心成效：一方面利用大數法則將梯度方差壓低至約 $\sigma^2/b$，收斂更穩定；另一方面將 $b$ 筆前向與反向運算打包為高吞吐矩陣乘法（Batch GEMM），發揮 GPU 龐大並行算力。因此文獻中所稱的「SGD」，實務上九成九皆指 Mini-Batch SGD！
312569087e41.en: Core effect: on the one hand, the law of large numbers pushes the gradient variance down to about $\sigma^2/b$, so convergence is more stable; on the other hand, the $b$ forward and backward computations are packed into high-throughput matrix multiplications (batch GEMM), harnessing the GPU's massive parallel compute. That is why, when the literature says "SGD", in practice it means mini-batch SGD 99% of the time!

6adbd5025358.zh: 在進入最佳化迴圈前，標準做法是將大小為 $n$ 的訓練資料集 $\mathcal{D}$ 隨機置換打亂（Shuffle），然後切分為 $\lfloor n/b \rfloor$ 個大小為 $b$ 的互斥子集 $\mathcal{B}_i$（Simple random sampling without replacement）：
6adbd5025358.en: Before entering the optimization loop, the standard practice is to randomly permute (shuffle) the training dataset $\mathcal{D}$ of size $n$ and then split it into $\lfloor n/b \rfloor$ mutually exclusive subsets $\mathcal{B}_i$ of size $b$ (simple random sampling without replacement):

3d962363847e.zh: 物理意義：所有子集聯集完整覆蓋整個訓練集 $\mathcal{D}$（式 23），且任意兩批次之間交集為空集（式 24）。這保證了在一個週期內，每個訓練樣本恰好被模型「看過且僅看過一次」！
3d962363847e.en: Physical meaning: the union of all the subsets covers the whole training set $\mathcal{D}$ (Eq. 23), and any two batches have an empty intersection (Eq. 24). This guarantees that within one cycle, every training sample is "seen by the model exactly once"!

e1313601f084.zh: 先對整個資料集進行全域隨機重排（Random Permutation），再依序切分成固定大小塊。保證資料利用完全均勻，杜絕偏差。
e1313601f084.en: First apply a global random permutation to the whole dataset, then cut it in order into chunks of fixed size. This guarantees the data is used completely evenly and rules out bias.

984cd477643d.zh: 每步獨立均勻地從 $\mathcal{D}$ 抽 $b$ 筆。批次間不再互斥（$\mathcal{B}_i \cap \mathcal{B}_j \neq \varnothing$），式 (24) 失效。約有 $1 - 1/e \approx 63.2\%$ 獨特樣本被抽中，其餘被遺漏。
984cd477643d.en: Each step independently and uniformly draws $b$ points from $\mathcal{D}$. Batches are no longer mutually exclusive ($\mathcal{B}_i \cap \mathcal{B}_j \neq \varnothing$), and Eq. (24) no longer holds. About $1 - 1/e \approx 63.2\%$ of the distinct samples get drawn, and the rest are missed.

fdcb015fbc3e.zh: 3. 為什麼深度學習偏好無放回？
fdcb015fbc3e.en: 3. Why does deep learning prefer sampling without replacement?

d122fa582e7b.zh: 無放回能確保每筆珍貴資料獲得平等的梯度貢獻，避免特定樣本被反覆過度訓練，同時有利於循序記憶體讀取與 DataLoader 預取快取。
d122fa582e7b.en: Sampling without replacement ensures that every precious data point makes an equal gradient contribution and keeps particular samples from being repeatedly overtrained; it also favors sequential memory reads and DataLoader prefetch caching.

efa23742f863.zh: 最後剩餘的 $n - b\lfloor n/b \rfloor$ 筆資料，常見處理方式為：保留為尺寸較小的最後一批，或在 DataLoader 中設定 drop_last=True 直接捨棄，避免批次大小動態變化損害 GPU 運算元編譯效益。
efa23742f863.en: The $n - b\lfloor n/b \rfloor$ data points left over at the end are usually handled in one of two ways: keep them as a smaller final batch, or set drop_last=True in the DataLoader to discard them outright, so that a changing batch size does not hurt the efficiency of GPU operator compilation.

dd74109a0456.en: Engineering note: in practice, the factor $1/b$ is sometimes absorbed directly into the learning rate $\eta$; the geometric direction of the gradient descent is exactly the same.

bb649f6fdae5.zh: 1. 為什麼 GPU 特別青睞 Mini-Batch？
bb649f6fdae5.en: 1. Why do GPUs especially favor mini-batches?

74da5efd6429.zh: 單樣本前向傳播是矩陣與向量乘法（GEMV），運算受限於記憶體頻寬；Mini-batch 將 $b$ 個輸入拼接為矩陣 $\boldsymbol{X} \in \mathbb{R}^{b \times d}$，前向與反向全轉換為通用矩陣相乘（GEMM），大幅提升運算強度與 Tensor Core 吞吐量。
74da5efd6429.en: Forward propagation of a single sample is a matrix-vector multiplication (GEMV), and the computation is limited by memory bandwidth; a mini-batch stacks the $b$ inputs into a matrix $\boldsymbol{X} \in \mathbb{R}^{b \times d}$, turning the whole forward and backward pass into general matrix-matrix multiplications (GEMM), which greatly raises arithmetic intensity and Tensor Core throughput.

dbf687debc37.zh: 2. 記憶體容量 vs 批次大小瓶頸
dbf687debc37.en: 2. The bottleneck of memory capacity vs batch size

08eed5f1c4fc.zh: 批次大小 $b$ 越大，反向傳播需暫存的前向啟用值（Activations）體積呈線性正比增加。當 $b$ 超過顯示卡 VRAM 上限時即引發 OOM，促使實務常採用梯度累積（Gradient Accumulation）在邏輯上擴大有效批次。
08eed5f1c4fc.en: The larger the batch size $b$, the larger the volume of forward activations that backpropagation must keep, in linear proportion. Once $b$ exceeds the graphics card's VRAM limit, OOM occurs, which is why practitioners often use gradient accumulation to enlarge the effective batch logically.

6d1be51cf150.zh: 3. 步長調整的線性縮放規律
6d1be51cf150.en: 3. The linear scaling rule for adjusting the step size

a1a199ce6497.zh: 當硬體算力允許將批次大小從 $b$ 擴大為 $k \cdot b$ 時，為了保持每個 Epoch 的總更新強度對齊，學習率通常需同步放大：$\eta \leftarrow k \cdot \eta$，並搭配學習率預熱（Warmup）防止訓練初期散逸。
a1a199ce6497.en: When the hardware compute allows the batch size to grow from $b$ to $k \cdot b$, then to keep the total update strength per epoch aligned, the learning rate usually has to be scaled up as well: $\eta \leftarrow k \cdot \eta$, together with a learning-rate warmup to keep training from diverging early on.

f67f61c794b7.zh: 4. 軟體實作：DataLoader 預取快取

cca136c532bd.zh: 現代框架使用多執行緒（Multi-worker）在 CPU 背景預先打亂、切塊並將批次資料非同步傳輸至 GPU 視訊記憶體（Pinned Memory），徹底消除 GPU 等待磁碟 I/O 的管線停頓。
cca136c532bd.en: Modern frameworks use multiple workers on the CPU in the background to shuffle and chunk the data in advance and transfer the batches asynchronously into GPU memory (pinned memory), completely eliminating pipeline stalls where the GPU waits on disk I/O.

e28a83ad8954.zh: 將小批次平均梯度視為全資料集真實梯度 $\nabla f(\boldsymbol{w}^{(t)})$ 與隨機近似誤差向量 $e_t$ 的疊加：
e28a83ad8954.en: Treat the mini-batch average gradient as the sum of the true gradient over the whole dataset, $\nabla f(\boldsymbol{w}^{(t)})$, and a random approximation error vector $e_t$:

1a82446fc6f0.zh: 當使用固定步長 $\eta^{(k)}=\eta$ 時，演算法收斂率界（Proposition 1）分為兩大情境：
1a82446fc6f0.en: With a fixed step size $\eta^{(k)}=\eta$, the algorithm's convergence-rate bounds (Proposition 1) fall into two main cases:

7bafd294ac76.zh: 一般凸或非凸函式 $f$（式 (27)）： $$ \min_{0 \le k \le t-1} \|\nabla f(\boldsymbol{w}^{(k)})\|_2^2 \le \mathcal{O}\left(\frac{1}{t}+\left\|e_{t}\right\|_{2}^{2}\right) \tag{27} $$
7bafd294ac76.en: General convex or non-convex functions $f$ (Eq. (27)): $$ \min_{0 \le k \le t-1} \|\nabla f(\boldsymbol{w}^{(k)})\|_2^2 \le \mathcal{O}\left(\frac{1}{t}+\left\|e_{t}\right\|_{2}^{2}\right) \tag{27} $$

d26ace0168f5.zh: 第一項：決定性收斂速度
d26ace0168f5.en: First term: the deterministic convergence speed

a22d7c3fcf1d.zh: 凸函式下以亞線性速度 $\mathcal{O}(1/t)$ 衰減；強凸條件下以幾何級數線性速度 $\mathcal{O}((1-\mu/L)^t)$ 快速收縮。隨著迭代步數 $t \to \infty$，第一項必然衰減歸零。
a22d7c3fcf1d.en: For convex functions it decays at the sublinear rate $\mathcal{O}(1/t)$; under strong convexity it shrinks fast, at the geometric (linear) rate $\mathcal{O}((1-\mu/L)^t)$. As the number of iterations $t \to \infty$, the first term is bound to decay to zero.

175c41fd7a0d.en: Second term: the random variance noise floor $\|e_t\|_2^2$

f838a4ea3507.zh: 代表 Mini-Batch 取樣噪聲所造成的不可消除極限底噪。在固定步長 $\eta$ 下，參數無法精確收斂到最優點 $w^*$，而是在極小值周圍半徑正比於 $\|e_t\|_2^2$ 的方差球內持續振盪！
f838a4ea3507.en: It represents the irreducible noise floor caused by mini-batch sampling noise. With a fixed step size $\eta$, the parameters cannot converge exactly to the optimum $w^*$; instead they keep oscillating inside a variance ball around the minimum whose radius is proportional to $\|e_t\|_2^2$!

a15428056be1.zh: 核心推論：增大批次大小 $b$ 能夠直接壓低誤差範數期望 $\mathbb{E}[\|e_t\|_2^2]$，使收斂界逼近 Full-batch 梯度下降的極限（式 (31)）。若要徹底消減此誤差底噪，必須配合學習率衰減排程（Learning Rate Decay）或 Polyak 平均。 Increasing batch size b shrinks the gradient approximation error norm ||e_t||^2, pulling convergence closer to full-batch rates at the cost of heavier per-step computation.
a15428056be1.en: Key corollary: increasing the batch size $b$ directly lowers the expected error norm $\mathbb{E}[\|e_t\|_2^2]$, bringing the convergence bound close to the limit of full-batch gradient descent (Eq. (31)). To eliminate this error floor completely, it must be paired with a learning-rate decay schedule or Polyak averaging.

ffdc6d81f895.zh: 梯度誤差期望分析：式 (29)–(30) 抽樣方差定理 Expected Gradient Error Norm: Finite Population Correction in (29)–(30)
ffdc6d81f895.en: Expected gradient error analysis: the sampling variance theorem of Eqs. (29)–(30)

052703ec845c.zh: 兩種抽樣機制下的誤差方差期望（式 (29)–(30)）
052703ec845c.en: Expected error variance under the two sampling mechanisms (Eqs. (29)–(30))

efb4c04a2dcb.zh: 設母體資料集梯度方差為 $\sigma^2 = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n \|\nabla f_i(w) - \nabla f(w)\|_2^2$：
efb4c04a2dcb.en: Let the gradient variance of the population dataset be $\sigma^2 = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n \|\nabla f_i(w) - \nabla f(w)\|_2^2$:

dde763268294.zh: $$ \begin{align*} & \mathbb{E}\left[\left\|e_{t}\right\|_{2}^{2}\right]=\left(1-\frac{b}{n}\right) \frac{\sigma^{2}}{b}, \quad \text{（without replacement，無放回抽樣）} \tag{29}\\ & \mathbb{E}\left[\left\|e_{t}\right\|_{2}^{2}\right]=\frac{\sigma^{2}}{b}, \quad \text{（with replacement，有放回抽樣）} \tag{30} \end{align*} $$

c90c92153872.zh: 關鍵因子：有限母體校正係數（Finite Population Correction, FPC）$(1 - b/n)$
c90c92153872.en: Key factor: the finite population correction (FPC) $(1 - b/n)$

5a95eaae0950.zh: 1. 有放回抽樣：標準 $1/b$ 獨立衰減
5a95eaae0950.en: 1. With replacement: the standard independent $1/b$ decay

26b6fabe834f.zh: 每次抽樣相互獨立，由獨立同分布大數法則可知，平均梯度的方差嚴格等於母體方差除以樣本數 $\sigma^2/b$。即使 $b \to n$，方差仍有 $\sigma^2/n > 0$。
26b6fabe834f.en: Each draw is independent, so by the law of large numbers for i.i.d. samples, the variance of the average gradient equals exactly the population variance divided by the number of samples, $\sigma^2/b$. Even as $b \to n$, the variance is still $\sigma^2/n > 0$.

8cfe776c3b27.zh: 2. 無放回抽樣：$b=n$ 時方差嚴格歸零
8cfe776c3b27.en: 2. Without replacement: the variance is exactly zero when $b=n$

ce91cee0ecb6.zh: 在無放回抽樣下，當 $b=n$ 時，係數 $(1 - b/n) = 0$，誤差方差嚴格歸零！此時小批次梯度與母體全梯度完全重合，不存在任何隨機性。
ce91cee0ecb6.en: Under sampling without replacement, when $b=n$ the factor $(1 - b/n) = 0$, and the error variance is exactly zero! The mini-batch gradient then coincides completely with the population's full gradient, with no randomness at all.

52187143eb52.zh: 3. 實務情境：巨量資料下兩者近乎等同
52187143eb52.en: 3. In practice: with massive data the two are nearly the same

5a445ad99f32.zh: 現代深度學習訓練集規模龐大（例如 $n = 10^6, b = 128$），此時 $b/n \approx 0.000128$，$(1 - b/n) \approx 0.99987 \approx 1$。兩者方差數值極為接近，但無放回確保了每個樣本在週期內不重複被取樣。
5a445ad99f32.en: Modern deep-learning training sets are huge (for example $n = 10^6, b = 128$), so $b/n \approx 0.000128$ and $(1 - b/n) \approx 0.99987 \approx 1$. The two variances are extremely close numerically, but sampling without replacement ensures that no sample is drawn twice within a cycle.

fa5894c8a70b.en: 4. The law of diminishing marginal returns on variance

a8ec1963545b.zh: 方差隨 $1/b$ 雙曲線下降：將 $b$ 從 1 提升至 32 可將方差降低 96.8%；但若要將方差再降一半，必須將 $b$ 再翻倍至 64。盲目追求低噪聲會耗費極其龐大的運算開銷。
a8ec1963545b.en: The variance falls along a $1/b$ hyperbola: raising $b$ from 1 to 32 reduces the variance by 96.8%; but to halve the variance again, $b$ must be doubled again, to 64. Blindly chasing low noise costs an enormous amount of computation.

2273d0bee9d3.zh: Batch Size 光譜：從微觀噪聲到宏觀吞吐的權衡 The Batch Size Spectrum: Microscopic Noise vs. Macroscopic Throughput
2273d0bee9d3.en: The batch-size spectrum: a trade-off from microscopic noise to macroscopic throughput

317f6f7ca3fe.zh: 深度學習中 Batch Size 的四個關鍵區間
317f6f7ca3fe.en: The four key ranges of batch size in deep learning

28012ca75e30.zh: 微批次區間 ($b = 1 \sim 8$)：噪聲極大，具備最強的隨機跳出局部極小能力；但 GPU 算力利用率極低，每步耗時大部分浪費在核心啟動（Kernel Launch Overhead）與記憶體傳輸。
28012ca75e30.en: Micro-batch range ($b = 1 \sim 8$): extremely noisy, with the strongest ability to jump randomly out of local minima; but GPU compute utilization is extremely low, and most of each step's time is wasted on kernel launch overhead and memory transfers.

b43dbc297e3e.zh: 甜蜜黃金區間 ($b = 32 \sim 256$)：工業界最主流設定。完美契合 GPU Warp（32 執行緒）與 Tensor Core 瓦片尺寸，計算達到 compute-bound，兼備平滑梯度與足夠噪聲。
b43dbc297e3e.en: Golden sweet-spot range ($b = 32 \sim 256$): the most mainstream setting in industry. It fits the GPU warp (32 threads) and Tensor Core tile sizes perfectly, so the computation becomes compute-bound, with both a smooth gradient and enough noise.

ce828260136c.zh: 大批次並行區間 ($b = 512 \sim 8192$)：多卡分散式資料並行（DDP）常用。可大幅提升總體吞吐量，但需搭配動態學習率線性縮放與 LARS/LAMB 等最佳化器，否則泛化能力嚴重退化。
ce828260136c.en: Large-batch parallel range ($b = 512 \sim 8192$): common in multi-GPU distributed data parallel (DDP) training. It can greatly raise overall throughput, but it must be paired with dynamic linear learning-rate scaling and optimizers such as LARS/LAMB; otherwise generalization degrades badly.

814bafe12dea.zh: 極限全批次區間 ($b = n$)：梯度精確確定，可使用高階牛頓類演算法；但在現代大模型中無法實施（視訊記憶體 OOM），且缺乏隨機噪聲導致模型容易卡死在尖銳鞍點。
814bafe12dea.en: Extreme full-batch range ($b = n$): the gradient is exact and deterministic, so higher-order Newton-type algorithms can be used; but it cannot be done for modern large models (GPU memory OOM), and the lack of random noise makes the model prone to getting stuck at sharp saddle points.

0895af5b56d7.en: Very strong (noise helps it jump out of local pits)

e01213793f0a.en: Good (moderate noise steers toward flat minima)

6763d0379498.en: Very weak (easily trapped at saddle points or in sharp pits)

9f27e92b5818.zh: 容易過度擬合尖銳極小值
9f27e92b5818.en: Prone to overfitting into sharp minima

15e7089fc25f.zh: 大師四大鐵律：Mini-Batch 與 Epoch 實踐憲章 Master Maxims: Four Inviolable Principles of Mini-Batch Optimization
15e7089fc25f.en: The master's four iron laws: a practical charter for mini-batches and epochs

d078e701508d.zh: 鐵律一：GPU 契合律（Hardware Alignment）

393f71fb7e59.zh: Batch Size 務必設定為 2 的冪次（32、64、128、256）或硬體架構瓦片尺寸倍數。這能確保 GPU Warp（32 threads）與 Tensor Core 矩陣單元對齊，杜絕執行緒閒置與記憶體跨行浪費。
393f71fb7e59.en: Always set the batch size to a power of 2 (32, 64, 128, 256) or a multiple of the hardware's tile size. This keeps GPU warps (32 threads) and Tensor Core matrix units aligned, eliminating idle threads and memory wasted across rows.

c0e088f30867.zh: 鐵律二：方差縮放律（Variance Scaling Law）
c0e088f30867.en: Iron law 2: the variance scaling law

412a7da77927.zh: 梯度估計方差以 $1/b$ 衰減。過度追求大批次帶來的降噪邊際收益遞減，卻會成倍犧牲每 Epoch 的更新次數與視訊記憶體；「適度噪聲」是模型訓練不可或缺的探索動力。
412a7da77927.en: The variance of the gradient estimate decays as $1/b$. Chasing ever larger batches brings diminishing marginal returns in noise reduction, yet sacrifices updates per epoch and GPU memory several times over; "moderate noise" is an indispensable driver of exploration in model training.

c718107f8b47.zh: 鐵律三：週期遍歷律（Epoch Traversal Rule）
c718107f8b47.en: Iron law 3: the epoch traversal rule

a8cfa650427c.zh: 嚴格執行無放回劃分式 (23)–(24)，且在每個 Epoch 開始前重新進行隨機置換（Shuffle）。防止固定批次組合產生週期性系統偏差，確保所有樣本均勻參與梯度回饋。
a8cfa650427c.en: Strictly follow the without-replacement partitioning of Eqs. (23)–(24), and redo the random permutation (shuffle) before every epoch. This prevents fixed batch combinations from producing periodic systematic bias and ensures that all samples take part evenly in the gradient feedback.

4b3991196cee.zh: 鐵律四：泛化平坦律（Flat Minima Principle）
4b3991196cee.en: Iron law 4: the flat minima principle

13ff94e63870.zh: Mini-Batch 隨機梯度噪聲扮演了強大的隱式正則化（Implicit Regularization）角色，能夠自動篩除泛化極差的尖銳極小值（Sharp Minima），引導參數收斂至寬廣平坦的優質低谷。
13ff94e63870.en: The random gradient noise of mini-batches plays a powerful role as implicit regularization: it automatically filters out sharp minima that generalize very poorly and guides the parameters to converge into wide, flat, high-quality valleys.

6868ec7a1462.en: 1. In Definition 1, what does one "epoch" mean?

194427653009.zh: A. 運算過程中完全不計算梯度

4ee8bb1cf0d6.en: D. The two are mathematically identical and use the same sampling scheme
